# Live Sports TV - Complete Platform & Stream Guide (llms-full.txt)

> LiveSportsTV (https://livesportstv.store/) is an international, free-to-air sports streaming directory and web player aggregating publicly broadcasted HLS channels across 64+ countries.

---

## 1. Platform Details
- **Website**: https://livesportstv.store/
- **Playback Engine**: HTML5 Video with native HLS.js adaptive bitrate streaming (1080p, 720p, 480p).
- **Supported Sports**: Football (Soccer), Cricket, Formula 1 / Motorsport, Basketball, Combat Sports (Boxing / UFC), Tennis.
- **Coverage**: Free-to-Air (FTA) official networks from Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia, and MENA regions.

---

## 2. Sports Hubs & Schedules
- **Football (Soccer)**: Premier League broadcasts, UEFA Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, FIFA World Cup.
- **Cricket**: ICC World Cup, T20 World Cup, Indian Premier League (IPL), Big Bash League (BBL), Pakistan Super League (PSL), Test cricket series.
- **Motorsport**: Formula 1 Grand Prix practice, qualifying, and Sunday race day broadcasts, MotoGP, IndyCar, World Rally Championship (WRC).
- **Combat Sports**: Professional boxing championship bouts, UFC Fight Night main cards, ONE Championship.
- **Basketball**: NBA regular season & playoffs, EuroLeague, FIBA Basketball World Cup.
- **Tennis**: Australian Open, Roland-Garros (French Open), Wimbledon, US Open, ATP Masters 1000.

---

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is LiveSportsTV?
LiveSportsTV is a free sports television directory providing direct access to legal, free-to-air sports streams and public television broadcasts worldwide.

### Is LiveSportsTV free to watch?
Yes, all channels on LiveSportsTV are 100% free with no subscription, registration, or credit card required.

### What devices are supported?
LiveSportsTV is fully responsive and supports desktop browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge), mobile smartphones (iOS & Android), smart TVs, and streaming boxes via modern HTML5 video.
